canonical_fixture_expansion.cartesian_rule: For every source_configuration, expand its generator into concrete matrices, pair every emitted matrix with every q in that configuration's q_values, and pair each such pair with every integer N in the resolved inclusive N range.
canonical_fixture_expansion.deduplication_rule: Deduplicate by exact equality of the canonical tuple. Retain sorted unique contributing configuration ids and scopes only as noncanonical provenance; they do not create additional tests or alter the tuple.
canonical_fixture_expansion.finite_N_rule: For each concrete matrix and q, include every integer N from 1 through resolved_max_N inclusive.

matrix_generation_rules.all_primitive_zero_one_matrices_in_lexic: Enumerate every dimension-by-dimension zero-one row-major vector in lexicographic order and retain exactly those matrices A for which A^k is strictly positive entrywise for some integer k at least 1.
matrix_generation_rules.explicit_matrix: Emit exactly the supplied matrix_row_major vector after verifying that its length is dimension squared.

canonical_fixture_expansion.ordering_rule: Sort the deduplicated canonical tuples lexicographically by q ascending, dimension ascending, matrix_row_major entry sequence, and N ascending.
canonical_fixture_expansion.resolved_max_N_rule: Use explicit max_N when present; otherwise use the largest integer N at least 1 for which dimension^N is at most assignment_cap.

digit_stream_expansion.cartesian_rule: Pair every digit_stream_control with every listed q and every listed depth.
digit_stream_expansion.deduplication_rule: Deduplicate by exact equality of the canonical digit-stream tuple.
digit_stream_expansion.digit_prefix_rule: Depth j uses exactly a_0 through a_(j-1) and the canonical residue sum from k=0 through j-1 of a_k times q^k.

formula_definitions.all_maximal_digits: a_j = q - 1 for every integer j at least 0
formula_definitions.all_zero_digits: a_j = 0 for every integer j at least 0
formula_definitions.alternating_zero_maximal_digits: a_j = 0 for even j and a_j = q - 1 for odd j
formula_definitions.polynomial_digits_a_j_equal_j_squared_pl: a_j is the canonical representative in {0,...,q-1} of j^2 + j + 1 modulo q

digit_stream_expansion.ordering_rule: Sort the deduplicated tuples lexicographically by digit_stream_control, q ascending, and depth ascending.

precision_expansion_rule: Run every interval-valued calculation at each precision_bits value in ascending order; exact-integer records have no precision coordinate.
